name: ui-click
prompt: A short, soft UI button tap: a gentle wooden click with a quick decay, warm and muted, no reverb tail.

name: plant-seed
prompt: A few small seeds dropped into soft garden soil: a faint patter of tiny taps followed by a soft earthy thud.

name: water-pour
prompt: Water poured from a metal watering can rose onto dry soil: a bright gentle sprinkle that fades as the soil soaks it up.

name: harvest-pick
prompt: A ripe vegetable pulled from the soil: a quick leafy rustle with a soft satisfying pop as the root comes free.

name: harvest-basket
prompt: Fresh produce dropped into a wicker basket: a light hollow knock of vegetables landing on woven reeds.

name: craft-tap
prompt: Assembling a small wooden craft item: two light mallet taps on wood followed by a soft squeak of parts fitting together.

name: order-fulfill
prompt: A cheerful small hand-bell rung twice to signal a completed delivery, bright and warm with a short natural ring-out.

name: crop-grown
prompt: A gentle magical shimmer as a young plant sprouts upward: soft chime-like sparkle with a hint of rustling new leaves.

name: crop-wither
prompt: Dry leaves crackling and wilting: a brittle papery rustle drooping downward, ending in a faint dusty sigh.

name: action-denied
prompt: A soft dull wooden thunk, like knuckles knocking once on a closed door: muted negative feedback, low and short.

name: pause-menu
prompt: A single soft marimba note struck gently, round and calm, with a short wooden resonance.

name: session-complete
prompt: A warm ascending bell arpeggio played on small tuned bells, celebratory but gentle, ending with a soft sustained chime.

name: season-turn
prompt: A gentle seasonal transition cue: a soft wooden wind chime swaying once in a warm breeze, with a distant airy whoosh of leaves passing by, calm and pastoral, no music.

name: undo-rewind
prompt: A short reverse whoosh with a soft paper flutter, like time rewinding one step: brief, airy, gently descending then cut off cleanly.

name: achievement-unlock
prompt: A small warm celebratory flourish on a toy glockenspiel: three rising bright notes with a soft sparkle tail, homely and modest rather than triumphant fanfare.
